.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-07-v14-quick/task/tests/gates/{constraints,render}/prompt.md, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md, plus all tests/**/*.md and *.toml (judge.toml criteria, app_context.md, scoring.toml) for n-gram and literal overlap
evidence: Skill Verify grep (case-insensitive) for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel, extended with probe|gate|grader|verifier|oracle|functional|polish|visual|render|constraints|harbor|mcp|test.sh|app_context, returned zero hits across instruction.md and all six /instructions notes. A wider grep for test|check|verify|evaluat|grade hit only instruction.md:5 (the newly appended sentence, 'please check it yourself the way I'll use it: type into the editor, run the code and save a snippet, and make sure nothing breaks') and security.md:5 ('dynamic evaluation through eval, Function...', a product security requirement). The new sentence is a user-voice self-check request: it names no judge, rubric, dimension name (functional/polish/visual/render/constraints), weight, test path, Playwright/MCP tool, restart tool or probe literal, and it restates actions already public in the brief/notes (edit code, run it, save snippets). Longest verbatim word run shared between instruction.md and any tests/**/*.md|*.toml text is 3 words ('there is no'); no 8-word n-gram from instruction.md or any note appears in any judge prompt, judge.toml criterion, app_context.md or scoring.toml. Extracting 116 backticked/hyphenated/upper-case literals from tests/** and checking them against the public text found only ordinary product words (case-sensitive, five-second, one-based, one-line, read-only, ready-made, two-space), all public requirements rather than grader sentinels; grader-only tokens such as cw_unsaved_marker, probe_ready and REWARDKIT_JUDGE appear nowhere in instruction.md, the notes or seed_data.json. Runtime facts present (port 3000, /api/health, DB_PATH, /app/app.db) are row-4 runtime contract, not grader machinery.
note: Counterexample attempts: (1) a weak app cannot exploit the brief because it discloses no probe literal, criterion id, dimension or fixture value to hard-code; the appended sentence only invites self-testing of public behavior. (2) A conforming builder cannot be misled into failing because the sentence adds no grader-specific expectation. Mild observation only: the sentence's three actions loosely mirror the gates' focus (editor, run, save), but that is ordinary product usage already stated in the brief, not grader vocabulary. Row is a static source review; no runtime measurement is required for it, so run_verdict stays NOT EXERCISED. Raw-evidence-index.json was absent at review time; not needed for this row.
